properties.decision: Anthony, 2026-10-25, after repair_report was run on reflow2's design for the first time (377 repairs: 87 corrected the cause, 2 standing patches each naming the proper fix still owed, 288 unlabelled): agreeing to "repair_report: worth one line in loop_status (\"2 standing patches, 288 unlabelled\")". So loop_status says, in one line, how many standing patches there are and how many repairs nobody labelled, and names repair_report for the detail. No new tool. The usage baseline (hub fact:flo2-usage-baseline-2026-10-25) found repair_report never called through flo2.io in a month.
